provenance: New local packed-word Boolean tables and fixed seven-round composition. Reuses the existing Boolean builder, packing helpers and pinned upstream message permutation/native compression as a differential oracle. No donor worktree, dependency pin, active Exec setup or backend identity was changed.

component_geometry.caveat: Standalone compression geometry only, not a new measurement of the full scalar interpreter. Larger outer nu and dense witness width can increase wiring, folds and PCS cost.

evidence: Independent native word arithmetic versus Boolean table rows; every single witness-column mutation rejected, including all carry and padding bits.
u32 carry-chain and overflow boundaries do not cross packed lanes.
All 512 original message basis bits routed through every round and output lane.
Poisoned in-place z/Az/Bz and stripe buffers match full matrix generation for counts 0,1,7,8,9,16 at nu=4.
All sixteen u32 compression outputs match pinned upstream for 64 private CV/message/counter/length/flag vectors; all composed gate rows checked.
Independent blake3 crate hash matches every single-block length from 0 through 64.
Identical count/compiled layouts, counts, registry digests and exact A/B/C matrices for 1,2,19 shared compressions.
Twenty decision diagrams compile deterministically and match native sparse bilinear evaluation at four F128 row/column points each.
component_tests.caveat: Native and matrix conformance tests, not a Lean proof of primitive or composition refinement. The component is raw compression, not the bounded multi-block hash or Exec relation.

native_proofs.command: ulimit -v 16777216 && RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 timeout 240 cargo test --release --locked --manifest-path flock-stage3/Cargo.toml private_compressions_verify_in_fresh_process_and_reject_broken_wiring -- --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture
native_proofs.security: Pinned embedded Fast128/m22 and BLAKE3 configuration, nu=9; no reduced-query override or m37 patch.
native_proofs.fresh_process_inputs: Only 64 bytes of externally expected full compression output and the serialized Flock bundle. Setup/public constants are reconstructed. Empty inherited environment, cwd outside the worktree; no private CV/message/parameters, gate evaluation or native hash invocation in the verifier branch.
negatives: Each of the four externally expected output words changed independently.
Commitment byte, last proof byte, truncation, trailing byte and transcript domain mutations.
One separately generated proof with a recomputed locally valid addition row violating fixed global wiring. Fresh verification rejects with Wiring(Gkr(ProductMismatch)).
native_proofs.scope: Real compression-component Flock proofs. Not execution proofs, FFLONK proofs, a full bounded-hash proof or an authenticated private-input statement.

terminal_component_tests.command: ulimit -v 16777216 && RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 timeout 240 cargo test --release --locked --manifest-path flock-stage4/Cargo.toml -p ixby-stage4-exec packed_blake3_tests -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture
terminal_component_tests.census_scope: Complete separate A/B table MLE gadgets for all ten new table types. Each has freshly allocated private row/column coordinates, a private claimed value and equality binding. No sharing of point/claim variables across the twenty components. Setup-only versus assigned projections have identical full projection objects and PLONK censuses; assigned outputs match native sparse bilinear evaluation.

materialized_representative.caveat: Only this representative root gadget was materialized. The other nineteen root gadgets use streaming projection, not full satisfaction checks. None is the complete terminal relation.

terminal_component_tests.excluded: All noncompression matrix roots, structure and jagged roots, transcript, Flock sumchecks, wiring, PCS, Exec statement binding, terminal preprocessing/proving and whole-pipeline resource admission.

historical_comparison.scope_difference: Historical two flattened A/B components allocate their points but not separate claimed-value inputs/equality checks; the twenty candidate components include those. This is a structural component-cost comparison, not a matched complete-relation census or controlled time comparison.
historical_comparison.interpretation: The lower matrix-root cost justifies testing an explicitly versioned integrated backend. It does not prove that the complete closed relation fits or that old keys can be reused.

resource_scope.timing_caveat: Ordinary tests and compilation overlapped parts of these checks. Durations are bounded regression observations, not controlled benchmarks. No terminal setup ceremony, large proving job or remote job was run.

next_gate: Wire this component into an explicit backend implementation choice, preserve the old default, test different byte/Exec inputs and malicious wiring under that choice, reject cross-backend proof/key substitution, and recensus the WHOLE closed relation before any full terminal materialization or proving.
